notes: Members are appointed by the Mayor. Seats are limited, so ask before applying. Check the commission website for the current application.
name: Baltimore City Youth Commission
what_you_do: Young people advise the Mayor, City Council and city agencies on policies and services that affect kids, youth and families. Seats are listed by council district.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 25. The city page lists seats by council district. The page does not state a residency rule.
pay_detail: Not stated on the city page.
duration: Term lasts until December 2028 for current members
deadline_text: No application window is posted. Two district seats (2 and 6) were shown as vacant in the member list.
how_to_apply: Contact the liaison, Tyron Rice, trice@baltimorecity.gov, 443-827-8421, to ask about open seats and the application.
